== Course of events ==

As the Scarecrow prepares to reclaim his throne from the Army of Revolt, the Queen of the Field Mice agrees to help by sending a dozen of her mice to hide within his straw-stuffed body, and she further agrees to run ahead and guide the travelers toward the Emerald City, since some enemy is trying to block their path. It is in this context that Nick Chopper, the Tin Woodman, blows a silver whistle to summon the Queen of the Field Mice, an old friend whose life he once saved.

The Queen answers the summons, her readiness to come at Nick Chopper's call reflecting the bond between them since he once saved her life. Afterward, the travelers continue on their way — Nick Chopper chops down the Saw-Horse's overly long new leg, and the group reaches the gates of the Emerald City, where the Queen of the Field Mice bids them farewell and darts off toward home.
